items.title: Kitchen remodels

sections.title: A builder who *swings the hammer*
body: Prescott & Sons Construction is a family owned and operated company that prides itself on being hands-on in the everyday construction tasks of its customers.

Not only are you hiring a licensed residential and commercial builder, you are hiring someone who knows how to build and remodel with his own hands. Josh and his crew are on site and dedicated to every project. Our company is committed to honest and dependable work at a fair price.

items.q: Who is the father and who is the son?
items.a: Josh began the business and has two sons and a daughter. You may meet any or all of them at some point on the job or at the office.

Yes. We carry workers' compensation and general liability, and we can always provide a certificate of liability insurance with more detail. That is something any contractor should be willing and able to supply.

items.q: Do I really need a licensed contractor for my renovation?
items.a: Absolutely. Would you go to a dentist who wasn't licensed?
